en.title: V
en.summary: The letter V is the twenty-third letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is spoken as the sound /v/. It makes the sound /v/ as in the word (vino) /ˈvi.no/, which means come. This letter makes only one sound in standard words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your upper teeth gently to your lower lip. Push air out steadily while your vocal cords vibrate. Feel your throat buzz with your fingers.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /v/ in all standard positions. Hear it clearly in the word (val) /val/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not swap this sound with the sound /w/ in water. Keep your top teeth firmly on your bottom lip. There is no other pitfall.
